description: Misread 'meet you where you are' as meaning the program should appear in the exec's existing channels (Teams, Outlook, Slack) with Improving running an invisible runtime. David corrected: the surface is the org's existing AI assistant, Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT, wherever their organization lives now.
correction: The exec-facing surface is whatever AI platform the client organization already uses. The offering is provider-agnostic: skills, guardrail guidance, and the log-review discipline must operate on top of Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT, not require an Improving-controlled runtime or a dedicated wrapper.
systemic_fix: When a phrase is ambiguous, confirm the intended meaning before building a structure on it; this is the second consecutive harness misread in the same thread.
